messages:
Maya (PM): quick intake — we need a concise, customer-visible "rollback reason" feed for model/route rollouts. Acme asked for something they can surface in their ops UI when a tenant fallback happens.
Alex (Eng): can you frame the problem? do we want raw errors, score diffs, or human-friendly reasons?
Maya (PM): problem: when we auto-fallback to a safer model variant (quantized -> full or v2->v1) customers only see a generic 500 or 'fallback triggered' in logs. They want actionable context (why, when, delta metrics) to reduce pager noise and speed troubleshooting.
Jo (CS): +1 from support — customers ask "was this a quality regression, capacity issue, or capacity policy?" We get inbox sprawl.
Priya (SRE): constraints: we can't ship PII or raw prompts in the feed. Also retention and cardinality matter for observability costs.
Sam (Research): we could attach eval-delta summaries (e.g., rouge/accuracy drop on a small prompt set) and a severity tag inferred from policy rules.
Maya (PM): goals:
- deliver a compact, customer-friendly rollback_reason string per request when fallback occurs
- include structured tags (reason_type: capacity|quality|policy|error) and a short human summary (<=140 chars)
- provide optional delta metrics (quantized_quality_delta=0.08) for tenants that opt in
- ensure no PII and comply with retention defaults
non-goals:
- not building full audit UI (we expose feed + examples, not UI itself)
- not including raw prompt text by default
success metrics:
- reduce customer escalations about fallback unknown-cause by 60% in 90 days
- reduce oncall wakeups for false-positive quality incidents by 30%
- <5% increase in log storage cost for customers that don't opt into deltas
acceptance criteria (minimal shipping):
- when a fallback happens, telemetry contains: reason_type tag, human_reason string, model_from/model_to, request_id, timestamp
- human_reason is <=140 chars and sanitized (no prompt substrings or user PII)
- feed can be queried by tenant_id and time range via Console and API (example query endpoints provided)
- opt-in flag for delta_metrics per tenant; default off
- docs + sample payload + privacy section published
Alex (Eng): technical notes: suggest implementing at router layer that already decides fallback. Emit an event to a new topic `rollback.feed.v1` with minimal fields. We'll add a sanitizer step before publish.
Priya (SRE): we need an ingestion QPS cap and aggregator to avoid high-cardinality spikes. propose sampling: emit full delta_metrics for 1% and only tags+summary for 100%.
Sam (Research): edge cases: intermittent latency-caused fallbacks where quality delta is zero — label as "capacity" and include latency percentile info instead of quality delta.
Jo (CS): customer-facing wording examples (for human_reason):
- "Capacity-constrained: routed to smaller model; increased latency caused fallback."
- "Quality regression detected vs baseline; rolled back to prior model."
- "Policy: tenant reached dedicated capacity limit; serving tier downgraded."
Maya (PM): privacy rules: no prompt text, no embeddings, no user tokens. If customer explicitly requires example prompts for diagnostics, require a legal/PO signed addendum + per-tenant opt-in and redaction pipeline.
deploy-bot: deploy queued for branch `rollback-feed` — CI passed — staging deploy at 2026-03-22T02:10:00Z
Alex (Eng): implementation rough timeline:
- week 1: router hook + event schema + sanitizer + unit tests
- week 2: sampling, aggregator, tenant opt-in flags, docs draft
- week 3: staging rollout to internal tenants, collect feedback
- week 4: GA gate and enablement playbook for CS/SRE
Priya (SRE): we need an SLO on feed delivery (event visible in Console within 30s 95th). Add to runbook.
Maya (PM): owner: Maya. Eng lead: Alex. SRE reviewer: Priya. Research: Sam for delta format. CS: Jo for wording and customer comms.
Alex (Eng): a couple of quick questions:
- do we want per-request feed payload (higher volume) or per-fallback-incident aggregated event?
Maya (PM): prefer per-fallback-incident (one event per fallback decision) — that keeps volume manageable and still maps to request_id(s).
Jo (CS): communication plan: we demo to top 5 tenants on opt-in before GA. Also add template email explaining privacy and opt-in.
Sam (Research): for delta_metrics format I'm proposing a small vector: {metric_name, baseline_value, current_value, sample_count}. Keep it lightweight.
Priya (SRE): approved sampling approach. Also add a hard cap per-tenant per-hour to avoid noisy tenants.
Maya (PM): next steps: Alex please drop a short RFC in #eng-platform by EOD Monday with schema and sample payload. Include privacy checklist. Priya please add SLO note to runbook. Jo will draft customer opt-in copy.
Alex (Eng): will do.
Jo (CS): will start outreach list (Acme + 4 others).
Maya (PM): thanks everyone. I'll attach this thread to the PRD stub in docs. If anyone has objections to the acceptance criteria above, shout now or open a thread.
Sam (Research): minor nit: include a severity score 0-1 for automatic triage. small follow-up in RFC.
Maya (PM): noted. closing for now — followups in eng RFC. :white_check_mark:
